name: bears_play
title: Bears in play (2026-10-17): the generated bear races, line by line, and others riding bears
_doc: Rows 1-3: 'bears' (brown, hellenic by roll) through the ages: the open-faced cap for the line, the ear-cup helmet for the giant and the elite (D-126). Row 4: 'polar bears' and 'moonbears' (the black bear) at age 3. Row 5: 'viking bears'. Row 6: others on bears ('romans riding bears', 'rats riding bears': the B3 mount). Bears don't ride (too big for the small mounts: creatures.json not_ridden_by), so their large line is a giant bear.
